name: mi-zhen-expert
description: A medical consultation routing expert that forwards questions to Med Agent Proxy.

displayDescription.en: Forwards each user question to the Med Agent Proxy service and returns the professional response without rewriting or mixing sources.
displayDescription.zh: 面向医疗健康咨询场景，透传用户原始问题给觅诊服务，原样返回专业回复，减少转述偏差，适合就医用药咨询。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想咨询一个健康或就医相关问题，请帮我转给觅诊服务回答。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a health or medical consultation question. Please forward it to the MiZhen service.

quickPrompts.en: I have a health or medical consultation question. Please forward it to the MiZhen service.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想咨询一个健康或就医相关问题，请帮我转给觅诊服务回答。

quickPrompts.en: Please help me ask which department I should visit for my symptoms.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我问问这些症状应该挂哪个科。

quickPrompts.en: Please help me ask about medication usage and precautions.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我咨询一下用药方法和注意事项。
